method: Measured signals only; no model predictions or prediction error used.
complete: Opening followed by stable hold near object. Stability: five median-filtered aperture frames within 3 px of final hold; abs distance <20 px.
ranking: Within each distance condition: RMSE from median measured aperture/distance shape, plus initial and final stability penalties. Analysis interval onset minus 0.3 s through stable plus 0.5 s, resampled to 101 points; aperture divided by 100, distance by initial distance. Invalid/gap penalties added.
data: Original full trials copied unchanged and SHA256 verified. Analysis alignment does not trim saved trials.
purpose: Typical presentation examples, not a replacement for all-trial evaluation.
